text.en: Believes a binomial random variable's variance equals n·p, the same as its mean, rather than n·p·(1−p), which is strictly smaller whenever 0 < p < 1.
text.et: Arvab, et binoomse juhusliku suuruse dispersioon on n·p, samamoodi kui keskväärtus, mitte n·p·(1−p), mis on rangelt väiksem, kui 0 < p < 1.
